nuclei is a vulnerability scanner using YAML templates. It supports custom detection scenarios based on real conditions, targeting minimal false positives.
Features
Some of the built in features include:
* Template Library
* Bulk Scanning
* Parallel Scanning
* Dynamic Variables
* Inclusion and Exclusion Filters
* AI-Powered Template Generation
